title: Weak Password Policy
description: Six-question password policy assessment. A 'False' verdict on any question indicates the policy does not meet that control. Accumulation of False verdicts determines overall vulnerability.

Q1_entropy.actual_question: Does the password policy enforce sufficient entropy (minimum length + character complexity: uppercase, lowercase, numbers, symbols)?

Q2_history_bypass.actual_question: Can password history be bypassed? (e.g. cycle through N passwords so the Nth+1 reuse of the original is accepted)

Q3_nist_expiry.actual_question: Does the password expiry policy align with NIST SP 800-63B? (NIST recommends NO mandatory periodic expiry unless compromise is suspected)

Q4_history_maintained.actual_question: Does the application maintain a history of the user's previous passwords to prevent reuse?

Q5_personal_info_rejected.actual_question: Does the policy reject passwords containing the user's first name, last name, or username?

Q6_common_passwords_blocked.actual_question: Does the policy reject common/dictionary passwords? (Test with a set of common passwords)
